paite: TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Israel suante, oliv thau chim tak, det dinga suk, khawnvak kuan sak gigena dingin na kianga honla dingin thupia in.
english: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

paite: Kihoupihna puanina thutheihpihna puanjak po lamah nitak lam akipan jinglam tan adingin TOUPA ma ah Aronin koih hoih hen: hiai bel na suante jel uh tana khantawn dan ding ahi.
english: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh continually: it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

paite: TOUPA maah khawnvak koihna siangthoutak tungah khawnvakte koih hoih jel heh.
english: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lampstand before Yahweh continually.

paite: Huan, tangbuang nel chi la inla, huai tanghou sawm leh nihin na bawl ding ahi: tanghou khat ah epha mun sawma khena mun nih zat ding ahi.
english: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenth parts of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel shall be in one cake.

paite: TOUPA maah dohkan siangthou tungah vual nihin, vual khata guk tuaktuakin na chiang ding ahi.
english: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before Yahweh.

paite: Tanghou tunga, a vual nih ah begaw chim tak na koih dia, theihgigena, TOUPA adia meia thillat bang a honghihtheihna dingin.
english: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Khawlni tengin TOUPA maah a koih hoih jel ding ahi: khantawn thukhun, Israel suante a ding ahi.
english: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is on the behalf of the children of Israel an everlasting covenant.

paite: Huan, Aron leh a tapate atuam ahi dinga, mun siangthou ah a ne ding uhi: khantawn dan dia TOUPA adinga meia thillatte laka, amah adia thil siangthou tak ahi, chiin.
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy to him of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

paite: Israel numei tapa, a pa Aigupta mi, mi khat Israel suante laka a vahoha: huai Israel numei tapa leh Israel mi, mi khat giahmun ah a kisual ua:
english: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

paite: Israel numei tapain hamsiatin Pathian min a gensiaa; huchiin Mosi kiangah a honpi uh. A nu min bel Selomit ahi a, Dan chi Dibri tanu ahi.
english: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

paite: TOUPA kam akipana thu pawt ngakna dingin suangkulh ah a khum uhi.
english: They put him in custody, until the will of Yahweh should be declared to them.

paite: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Hamsiat loupa dainawl ah pi unla, a theihpihte tengtengin a lu ah a khut uh koih uhenla, mi tengtengin suangin deng uhen.
english: “Bring out of the camp him who cursed; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

paite: Huan, Israel suante houpih inla, a kianga uah, Kuapeuh a Pathian hamsiat loh peuhmahin a khelh moh a po ding.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

paite: Huan, TOUPA min gense peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi: mi tengtengin suanga a den ngeingei ding uh: TOUPA min a gensiat u leh gam dang mi leng, hiai gama mi him leng hihlup ding ahi.
english: He who blasphemes the name of Yahweh, he shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him: the foreigner as well as the native-born, when he blasphemes the Name, shall be put to death.

paite: Si khopa mi tunga khut kha peuhmah mi jaw hihlup ngeingei ding ahi;
english: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

paite: Si khopa ganta tunga khut kha peuhmahin a dit ding ahi: hin sikin hin.
english: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

paite: Huan, min a insakinkhang a melsiatsak leh a hih bang geih a tunga hih sam ding ahi;
english: If anyone injures his neighbor; as he has done, so shall it be done to him:

paite: Guh kitan sikin guh kitan, mit sikin mit, ha sikin ha; mi a hihmelsiat bangin a tungahleng hih sam ding ahi.
english: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he has injured someone, so shall it be done to him.

paite: Ganta hihlum peuhmain a dit ding ahi; mi hihlum peuhmah hihlup sam ding ahi.
english: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

paite: Gam dang mite ading leh hiai gama mi himte adingin dan kibang khat na neih ding uh ahi: Kei TOUPA na Pathian ka hi hi, na chi ding ahi, chiin.Huchiin Mosiin Israel suante a houpiha, hamse loupa pen dainawl ah a pi khia ua, suangin a deng uh, Israel suanten TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak bangin a hihta uh.
english: You shall have one kind of law, for the foreigner as well as the native-born: for I am Yahweh your God.’”

paite: Huchiin Mosiin Israel suante a houpiha, hamse loupa pen dainawl ah a pi khia ua, suangin a deng uh, Israel suanten TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak bangin a hihta uh.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought out him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
